PROVINCIAL LABOUR LAWS
PROVINCIAL LABOUR
LAWS
(APPLICATION TO
THE TRIBAL AREAS OF BALUCHISTAN)
REGULATION, 1974
REGULATION III OF
1974
A Regulation to apply certain Provincial labour laws to
the tribal areas of the Province of Baluchistan
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 29th July 1974]
No. Legis. 4-17/Law/70.-----The
following Regulation made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 29th July,
1974, is hereby published for general information:-
Preamble.-Whereas it is
expedient to apply the provisions of certain. Provincial labour laws and the
rules made thereunder from time to time, to the tribal areas of the Province of
Baluchistan;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred upon him by clause (4), of Article 247 of the Constitution
of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Baluchistan, with the
prior approval of the President, is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Regulation, namely:
1. Short title extent and
commencement.-(1) This Regulation may be called the Provincial Labour Laws
(Application to the Tribal Areas of Baluch istan) Regulation, 1974.
(2) It extends to the tribal
areas of the Province of Baluchistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Application of certain
Provincial labour laws to the tribal areas of the- Province of Baluchistan.----The
provisions of the Provincial labour laws set forth in the Schedule to this
Regulation, and the rules, orders, notifications, bye- laws or directions made
or issued thereunder from time to time, shall apply to the tribal areas of the
Province of Balichistan as they apply to the other areas of the Province.
